name: Bunny Flags
description:
About This Game

After 15 years, the web tower defense game returns as a full roguelite.

Infiltrate enemy bases, plant Bunny Flags, and hunt down Racabat — the power-hungry raccoon general who invaded our homeland. Two years have passed since the Raccoons’ invasion forced the last resistance fighters into hiding. Now General Thorne is coordinating a secret assault from Flying Falcon HQ, and only you can handle the critical missions.

You are the legendary resistance fighter of the Bunny Army, a warrior with no fear of going alone against the raccoons. You have the full support of your commander, General Thorne, who is waiting for results at Flying Falcon HQ.

Infiltrate the enemy bases, our former land, survive the increasing raccoon attacks and take control by planting 5 of our own flags. Capturing flags grants you temporary perks, abilities and weapons that can turn the tide of the run. Once the 5 flags are captured, Racabat will appear. Find him and destroy him.


Beware of the raccoons and the finger enemies, as they react to your every move and will push harder and faster to capture your flag and destroy you in every run. If they steal your flag, recover it as fast as possible, because if they take it home the run ends. And let’s not forget your number one enemy, Racabat, the greedy raccoon general who started this war and is currently hiding from your wrath. But don’t get cocky — he will be prepared to fight you, now and in every future run.



You start with limited gear and will gain experience across runs to unlock new weapons, abilities, perks and traits — with over 50 already active in the game and more on the way. Some raccoons carry special weapons and health kits, so use them to your advantage. As you progress you will unlock more of the map that guides you to the next base to conquer (just press Tab to access it).

Select your loadout carefully, because every combination changes how you play.
Positioning and timing are the keys to your success.

Play the free demo, die a few times, and tell us what you think.
Then wishlist the full game so you don’t miss the complete war.
short_desc: Sarge is BACK. Tactical roguelite top-down shooter. Infiltrate bases, plant flags, choose your loadout, and hunt Racabat. High replayability. Free demo available.
